description: Current AirAsia MOVE brand mark (post-Feb-2024 rebrand of airasia Superapp): red 'AirAsia' cloud over the green 'move' wordmark on the brand tile. Self-contained lockup; the tile guarantees legibility on any background.
canonical_owner: AirAsia / Capital A Berhad — official brand at https://www.airasia.com and https://newsroom.airasia.com/news/airasiamovenewlogo-en
processing: Sourced at 2000x947, tightly trimmed to content bounding box (2000x825), alpha preserved. No recoloring.
usage: Cover (slide 1) partner logo lockup on the AirAsia MOVE deck, co-branded top-right opposite the Navier wordmark on the dark navy cover.
disambiguation: This is the CONSUMER AirAsia MOVE travel super-app mark (red+green). Do NOT substitute the dark-teal 'move DIGITAL' corporate-wing logo (formerly AirAsia Digital), which is a different entity and is unusable on the navy cover.
notes: StickPNG hosts a mirror of the official app icon; the canonical trademark owner is AirAsia / Capital A. Use on the AirAsia MOVE partner proposal addressed to AirAsia. If a vector/source-file lockup from AirAsia brand is later obtained, prefer it and re-bank.
